en.topic_title: High Court judge to be reprimanded again for plagiarism as Judiciary flags ‘substantial’ copying
en.topic_summary:
A High Court judge with a history of plagiarism will be reprimanded for yet another incident in which he copied large parts of a party’s submissions into his judgement.



High Court Judge Wilson Chan. Photo: Judiciary. 



The Judiciary said in a reply to HKFP on Wednesday that High Court Judge Wilson Chan will receive a “serious reprimand” from Chief Justice Andrew Cheung and Chief Judge of the High Court Jeremy Poon over the judicial copying case
